title: Review of c55's Schroedinger-Poisson negative on fresh seed 45 (damped, fed arm, and the same at world dt/2): a few clumps with axis-aligned jets, 0 persistent tracks, merge/split 1.0-1.1
summary: Labkit runs of the finding's world.py on seed 45 with its damped, fed setting (eta 0.05, g 0.02, sig 0.002, G 1e-3), 128^2, 200 frames x 50 steps (t=2000), and the same at the world's own dt halved (dt 0.1, 100 steps per frame). Default dt: 6 clumps at the end, 791 tracks, longest 12 frames (120 t), 0 persistent tracks, 177 splits against 190 merges, 0 persistent splits, 256 nucleations; matter is flung out along the grid axes in straight jets (sheet t=440-2000). dt/2: 5 clumps, 731 tracks, longest 110 t, 0 persistent splits, merge/split 1.01.

observations.I: rerun/seed45/FACTS.md: 0 persistent tracks, longest 120 t, merge/split 1.07; rerun/seed45_dthalf/FACTS.md the same (longest 110 t, 1.01); sheet shows axis-aligned jets as the finding reports

seeds_run.result: pass (negative replicates, also at world dt/2)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed at the fed setting only. The jets survive halving dt, so they are not a time-step artifact; a grid (dx) variant would test the finding's reading that they are a grid artifact.
